name: No Mercy [Early Access]
desc:
🔈“WELCOME TO THE LIVE GAMESHOW: NO MERCY!! Audience cheering sfx”🔈

A fast paced multiplayer platformer where theres no time to catch your breath. Survive round after round for your cruel audience’s entertainment, with each growing closer to your last. Will you persevere through their laughter and escape, or will you embrace their applause to your demise?
Use Reputation (REP) to customise yourself or unlock Skills to survive longer. 
Just whatever you do. Don’t. Fall. Off.

Always make sure you put on a good show for them. After all….they came here…for YOU.

Max lobby count currently: 50 players

Graphics level 5+ recommended 

⚠️EARLY ACCESS RELEASE: CHECK INGAME ROADMAP FOR DETAILS ON FUTURE UPDATES⚠️

⭐️Join the group for 250REP⭐️
